name: WiseAI
about: Empowering businesses with AI-driven customer service and sales solutions.

personas.name: Oleksandr Bondarenko
personas.role: Tech lead of the AI agent
personas.style: Polite technical Polish with some calques from Ukrainian. Gives the issue key and the exact change.

personas.name: Iryna Melnyk
personas.style: Quotes what the pilot customers said. Sometimes adds a Ukrainian word such as 'diakuju' at the end.

personas.name: Kornelia Sęk
personas.style: Short bug report style: what happened, what she expected, then the request.

personas.name: Robinho Nasario
personas.style: Charming salesman. Polish with Portuguese and English words (amigo, top, incrível). Names important people that he met and turns each problem into an opportunity. The request is clear.

personas.name: Yuliia Marchenko
personas.style: Short messages with exact slide numbers and dates.

personas.name: Hubert Kałuża
personas.style: Sales slang (lead, pipeline, closing). Very optimistic about each meeting.

personas.name: Nataliia Lysenko
personas.style: Formal language of applications: cel projektu, wskaźniki, harmonogram, budżet.

personas.name: Taras Hnatiuk
personas.style: Numbers and tables. Asks for one exact value or one change.

personas.name: Danuta Wrzos
personas.style: Old-school consultant. Long formal sentences, reminds about deadlines and the rules of the call.

personas.name: Oksana Savchuk
personas.style: Exact amounts in PLN and invoice numbers. Calm and brief.

personas.name: Bohdan Moroz
personas.style: Brief status updates. Asks for lists of issues and their state.

personas.name: Wiesława Gąsior
personas.style: Worried tone. Asks to check each thing twice and to keep the documents.

personas.name: Dmytro Kravets
personas.style: English technical words, very short lines, often writes about night deployments.

personas.name: Serhii Polishchuk
personas.style: Polish without Polish letters. Many questions, but one clear request.

personas.name: Anastasiia Klymenko
personas.style: Talks about the cost of tokens and the names of the models.
